risks.impact: Missing or unauditable legacy source prevents defensible legacy findings.
risks.trigger: No owner-designated revision, access or licensing/provenance metadata.
risks.mitigation: Read-only intake with explicit revision and hashes; do not copy or infer code.
risks.owner_action: Owner supplies designated source; agent verifies read-only intake.
risks.unblock_condition: Accessible authorized revision, provenance/license decision and input hashes.

risks.impact: Unsupported equations/parameters can invalidate scientific outcomes.
risks.trigger: Required source/domain/calibration/independent validation missing or contradicted.
risks.mitigation: Keep provisional/unavailable; stop owning model gate; preserve negative results.
risks.owner_action: Agent investigates primary evidence; owner supplies unavailable private data if authorized.
risks.unblock_condition: Source, units, applicability, uncertainty and mandatory reference/empirical gates verified.

risks.impact: Silent source substitution changes the approved network behavior.
risks.trigger: Approved PLC source set unavailable or proposed replacement lacks evidence/ADR.
risks.mitigation: Retain current approved source set; no guessed substitute.
risks.owner_action: Agent audits source set and accepted change decisions.
risks.unblock_condition: Traceable source set and evidence-backed accepted ADR for any change.

risks.impact: Unavailable tool/platform prevents required integration evidence.
risks.trigger: Mandatory platform/tool smoke test cannot run or fails.
risks.mitigation: Record NOT RUN/FAIL; isolate adapter and investigate; do not claim support.
risks.owner_action: Agent installs authorized routine dependencies and records real versions.
risks.unblock_condition: All required real smoke/integration checks pass on claimed platforms.

risks.impact: Corrupt/partial data can invalidate downstream metrics and analyses.
risks.trigger: Conservation, schema, provenance/hash or raw-data completeness fails.
risks.mitigation: Stop pipeline and dependent analysis, mark failed, preserve inputs/logs/reproducer.
risks.owner_action: Agent diagnoses integrity defect and retains regression.
risks.unblock_condition: Integrity cause resolved and required rerun/reference checks pass.

risks.impact: Unauthorized irreversible/paid/private action can violate owner constraints.
risks.trigger: Specific action lacks required explicit authorization or external permission.
risks.mitigation: Prepare reviewable result, record action/risk and request only missing authorization.
risks.owner_action: Owner or external authority authorizes specific action; agent preserves state.
risks.unblock_condition: Explicit applicable authorization and external permission verified.

risks.impact: False acceptance can advance roadmap on failing or stale tests.
risks.trigger: Mandatory check fails, is unavailable or belongs to different head.
risks.mitigation: Investigate/retest; do not merge or mark completed; preserve exact-head evidence.
risks.owner_action: Agent verifies commands and GitHub runs; record protection blocker if denied.
risks.unblock_condition: All mandatory local/scientific gates and exact-head CI pass; normal merge permitted.

risks.impact: Unsupported causal/statistical claims can misrepresent results.
risks.trigger: Estimand, design, dependence, repetitions, diagnostics or preregistration absent.
risks.mitigation: Retain raw data; stop unsupported inference; do not select favorable results.
risks.owner_action: Agent documents design and independent analysis evidence.
risks.unblock_condition: Required design/diagnostic/analysis and raw-data gates verified.
